events.title: Devlog #2 - Fast and Furious
events.summary: This update is about performance: the demo loads much faster and runs smoothly on weak laptops and on the Steam Deck. Plus changes to Horde mode (difficulty instead of map, a tougher curve, Challenge Altar), and rebalanced runes. Highlights The demo flies on weak machines. We measured with a low-end integrated GPU (Vega 8 class) simulated on our PC: from about 30 FPS to 60 on Low, Medium and High. On Steam Deck, Low and Medium run at 60 FPS. events.title: Devlog #1 - The Abyss Goes 3D
events.summary: Our biggest update yet: the game moves to a 3D world, gets a brand-new UI, the Atlas becomes Nodes and every weapon effect is repainted. Highlights The world is 3D. Terrain, water, grass, props and enemies all move into a world with real depth. Same ink-and-cartoon look as always, but now everything has volume and casts a shadow. The arena is a floating island.
